messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — this week's release train will use regional canaries for the v3.9 model rollout. Quiet window starts Fri 18:00 UTC -> Mon 08:00 UTC. Please avoid non-critical deploys during that window. :warning:
morgan: what counts as 'non-critical' here?
alex: anything not tagged emergency or security. If you need an exception, use /request-embargo and tag @release-coordinator. Include: reason, rollback plan, owner, max-impact.
jen: Can confirm the canary ramp: eu-west 5% -> after 30m 25% -> after 2h ramp to 100% if no regressions. Monitoring thresholds: p95 latency >150ms OR error rate +0.3% => auto-rollback. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
devops-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze starts in ~48 hours. Calendar: https://go/release/calendar
iqbal: Infra note — we'll disable quantized kernels on NVLink nodes during the rollover to avoid KV cache invalidation. Ops will re-enable post-cutover.
sasha: quick question — can teams request an extended canary window? Our feature needs an extra 30m.
alex: yes — rollback budget can be extended by 30m for teams that file a canary-extension ticket in RELEAS-OPS. DM me if urgent.
morgan: tagging @security — is extra audit logging needed for this rollout? It's customer-data adjacent.
security: we'll enable verbose audit-level logging for affected routes during the rollover and retain for 90 days. We'll also watch for anomalous access patterns. :lock:
alex: TL;DR: quiet window Fri 18:00->Mon 08:00 UTC; regional canary ramp 5->25->100; exceptions via /request-embargo; contact alex for canary extensions. Thanks! :pray:
release-coordinator: Exception process and runbook posted: https://go/release/embargo-exceptions and https://go/release/runbooks/regional-canary.md
devops-bot: Note: CI gates will block merges to main during the quiet window. Use merge-staging for urgent patching.
